sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 22 and Internal Quality Checks row 22, sheet rows 23)
evidence: Static inspection: tests/Dockerfile ships every item the row and skill section 22 name. Judge CLI pinned: tests/Dockerfile:17 '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281' (matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code" at task.toml:31; codex also pinned at :18). Playwright MCP pinned: :19 '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79'. Browser: :33-38 installs chromium with the playwright CLI bundled inside that pinned MCP package (so the Chromium build is fixed by the pin), into PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/playwright-browsers, made world-readable and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which is exactly the path every judge.toml passes ('--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium', command 'playwright-mcp'). RewardKit pinned: :31 'harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7'. python3 for the restart server: base 'python:3.12-slim' (:2); scored/functional/judge.toml uses command '/usr/local/bin/python3' with /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, which the image copies at :43. App runtime: Node 22 copied from node:22-bookworm-slim (:1,:4), 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' installed globally (:20-21) with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (:9), identical versions and NODE_PATH to environment/Dockerfile:3,10-11; test.sh:104-111 launches with the same NODE_PATH. The golden server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5), so it starts in the verifier image without /app/node_modules; setpriv/setsid used by test.sh come from util-linux (:13), procps is present. tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/.dockerignore and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff shows no difference), so no task-specific drift. Suite budgets fit the image's verifier timeout: gates 1500 >= 600+600, scored 11100 >= 9000+900+900, total 12600 < 13200. Runtime: the verifier image was NOT built or run for these exact bytes; the scripted golden ran in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image (index limitation). A hosted run on an earlier candidate (reward.json: render 1.0, constraints 1.0, functional 1.0, polish 1.0, visual 0.9167, graded 1; app-restart.sh.used present) shows this template verifier image launching the app, driving the browser, restarting and grading on a near-identical task, but it is not a measurement of these bytes. Required full-verifier launch evidence for this input hash is therefore missing, hence risk=true. Notes (not defects, template-controlled): base images are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned, and apt packages plus 'playwright install --with-deps' system libraries are unpinned; the rewardkit agents.py patch at :41 asserts its anchor, so a mismatch would fail the build loudly rather than grade wrongly. Counterexample search: a submission that requires a module other than express/better-sqlite3 without shipping node_modules would fail to start in the verifier, but the agent image has the same two global modules and the same NODE_PATH, so that failure is the submission's and is visible to the agent; a conforming app shipping its own /app/node_modules is copied with /app and resolves normally. No harness-attributable failure found.
